propositions: The corpus size constant (113) drifts against live ticket state because membership is re-derived at runtime from ticket classifications rather than pinned by commit identity.
Reclassifying historical tickets to/from bug type or changing subject prefix resolution causes the corpus count to move, breaking the size assertion.
The corpus is claimed 'pinned and reproducible' in the module docstring but is actually a moving derivation, creating a contract mismatch.
The fix replaces the size constant with a frozenset of 113 commit SHAs and derives check-mode assertions from that pin instead of live ticket state, making it immune to tracker churn.
The check mode must still fail if the flagged set diverges from ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE or any pinned SHA becomes unmeasured.
